scenes.text: Perimeter is the distance around a flat figure. Add all sides or use 2(length plus width).
Find the perimeter of a 8 cm by 7 cm rectangle. The answer is 30 cm. P equals 2(l plus w) gives 30 cm.
A rectangular garden at a farm measures 16 cm by 3 cm on a model. What is its perimeter? Pause the video and think.
